top_events.title: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
top_events.label: Ukraine destroys part of Crimean Bridge
top_events.summary: Ukrainian forces partially destroy the strategic Crimean Bridge with missiles and drones after weeks of planning. The attack disrupts a key Russian supply route and escalates the Black Sea conflict near Romania's region.

top_events.title: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
top_events.label: Trump Putin Xi hold first trilateral summit
top_events.summary: The three leaders meet for the first time in a closely-watched summit. No concrete outcomes yet; the diplomatic development could affect regional security but remains at the rhetoric stage.

top_events.title: Five EU states announce plans for immigration 'return hubs' in Rwanda
top_events.label: Five EU states plan Rwanda return centers
top_events.summary: Germany, Austria, Netherlands, Denmark, and Greece announce joint offshore immigration centers in Rwanda. The controversial policy signals a shift in EU migration approach but faces legal challenges.
